newsitem.title: USA: Huntingdon sees full year profit below 1996.
newsitem.headline: Huntingdon sees full year profit below 1996.

text.p: Huntingdon Life Sciences Group PLC said Tuesday it expects its pre-tax full year profit will be "substantially below" 1996 profits.
It also said it expects to report a small loss on ordinary activities before taxes in six month period ended June 30.
The company said the loss will come after it pays exceptional costs in the six month period ended June 30 of $1 million in British sterling.
The exceptional costs come from management changes, adviser' fees, additional marketing expenses and study costs arising from its response to allegations from animal rights groups.
The loss will come from translations costs of about Sterling 0.6 million arising on consolidation of the 7 and 1/2 convertible capital bonds.

The company also said it expects profit on ordinary activities before tax in the 12 months ending December 1997 will be below 1996 profits of Sterling 9.4 million because monthly new orders of Sterling 4-5 million have recently been below its expectations.
The company said it expects it will return to profitability in 1997.
